title: status_callback_url does naive concat; a trailing slash on TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL yields a //webhooks/twilio-sms path
detail: Empty base is guarded (omits callback) but a trailing slash is not. base="https://host/" produces "https://host//webhooks/twilio-sms", which may not match the rc3-6 route, silently losing every delivery-status callback.
recommended_fix: Trim a trailing '/' from base before concat (normalize in init(), or guard in status_callback_url) so a trailing-slash TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL resolves to the single-slash route.
